v1_plain_sycl.result: TILEDATTN-OK, 2.83e-06, but 37ms @4K (0.5 GB/s) — scalar inner loops; SLM sharing can't beat compute density
v1_plain_sycl.lesson: traffic was 2% of time; sharing it while scalarizing compute loses

v2_esimd.result: 19.1ms @4K, 2.78e-06 — 2x on v1 via vector compute, still 2x BEHIND the 24-WI vector kernel (9.8ms)
v2_esimd.lesson: per-head compute is identical with/without sharing (every head scans all T); sharing saves only traffic. Occupancy (24 WIs on 160 EUs) is the binding constraint, not traffic.

pivot: GEMM-form attention: QK as DPAS GEMM (prefill-style) instead of GEMV-scan. T3.7's pending causal-tiled-prefill item is the same machinery.

qk_gemm_primitive.kernel: _ZTS6QkGemm (fp16 Q x BF16-cache strided, bf16 DPAS, fp32 accum)
qk_gemm_primitive.read: 22x on the QK portion (135us vs ~3ms scan-QK). DPAS engages weakly (T3.4 caveat live) but the FORM wins anyway; occupancy-thin at 768 groups (60% of HW threads).
qk_gemm_primitive.note: B reads cache directly with stride (no transpose, no SLM-B); A staged once; partial-M guard present but untested (T multiple of 16 assumed)

next: WV-GEMM (weights x V, same skeleton, fp16-converted weights) + hybrid fuse (QK-GEMM + vector softmax/WV or full GEMM) targeting ~0.5ms @4K (~20x). Then real-weight + adoption.
